description: This file is a performance testing framework for Git, providing functions and setup to run performance tests, create repositories, and measure execution times.

methods.name: die_if_build_dir_not_repo
methods.description: Checks if the build directory is a Git repository and exits if not.

methods.name: test_perf_copy_repo_contents
methods.description: Copies the contents of a source repository into a target directory, excluding certain special directories.

methods.name: test_perf_create_repo_from
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository from a source directory or repository.

methods.name: test_perf_fresh_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new empty Git repository at a specified directory.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Creates a repository from the default GIT_PERF_REPO.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Creates a large repository from the specified GIT_PERF_LARGE_REPO.

methods.name: test_checkout_worktree
methods.description: Checks out all files in a Git worktree.

methods.name: test_run_perf_
methods.description: Runs a performance test command with timing and environment setup.

methods.name: test_wrapper_
methods.description: Wraps a test with setup, prerequisites, and result handling, also logs timing results.

methods.name: test_perf_
methods.description: Performs the actual performance measurement, repeated multiple times.

methods.name: test_size_
methods.description: Performs a size measurement test with setup and prerequisites.

methods.name: test_size
methods.description: Wrapper for size test with options.

methods.name: test_at_end_hook_
methods.description: Hook to perform aggregation of results at the end, unless an aggregating flag is set.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq
methods.description: Checks a prerequisite lazily with environment variable evaluation.
